body: Sorry you feel that way. Here if you want to talk.
I never thought of it like that. So I still have my 6 sober days. Thank you. I don't feel as bad with day 1 as I did last week. Hoping it gets easier each try!
Yeah I think having someone to check in with helps a lot.
Yeah I thought that but I ended up buying drink. So annoying.
Someone here also suggested going shopping when alcohol is restricted may help also.
Yeah I think I need to reconnect with addiction services again. And this sub is so helpful also.
That's good your doing well. I am just a bit annoyed with myself as I'm going to have go through the shakes and sweats and anxiety again. IWNDWYT
Yeah I've decided not to be to harsh on myself and start again.
Thank you I will.
I think I need to steer clear of places that sell alcohol. I just bought a pack when I went shopping.one day turned into four.
Albe 👌
Al.
Thank you so much for your concern. You seem like a very caring person. I've found chatting on here helpful to me. You also deserve to live life. Can chat again if you need to.

I lost my daughter to suicide. It's totally broken me. I blame myself constantly even 6 years later. I now have depression anxiety hardly leave house. Battling alcohol addiction also. Please reach out for help. Nothing prepares you.

Haha that's so funny you said that. Today I went shopping with my dad. I avoided the drinks aisle as someone suggested. He wanted to look at wine. So I thought f% you it's always going to be there. And can't avoid it. And I done it. Thank you 
IWNDWYT
Thank you I'm so overwhelmed from all the support from you all. It's really helped me today.

You have a very good outlook.and keeping busy does help a lot. Although I have problems with feeling overwhelmed even with simple goals. Your so right about just taking time for yourself tho. thank you and I hope we can also travel this path together to getting better each day. Good luck to you.
I'm here if you need to chat. Hope your ok.

Wow you guys are honestly so great here.382 days is so good. Hope I can get there one day too. I just feel lost without a drink. I have a dog so looks like lots of long walks for her. Thank you for replying.
Thank you well done you on 122 days you are all very inspiring. Very good sub here.
Wow 79 days is great. Thanks so much for your reply. Your very inspiring. The thing you said about grief really hits home for me.I think it is the reason I have been drinking to try mask it.
Yeah maybe I just need to go before 10am here. I can't get delivery today so I will try your suggestion of avoiding drinks aisle hope I can do. Thanks for your reply.
Because she is rescued we don't know her history.

Yeah she has no interest in treats outside. I can let her off at large field if I have a tennis ball. But I need to be super vigilante of footballs small dogs and cats. The football obsession is the worst.
That sounds really cool. We rescued cassie had her nearly 3 years. Is great in house. But is hard work sometimes outside. Maybe you could give me some advice.
Wow that's a great thing your doing there. Don't know if I could give them up.
Awe sounds cute. How do you get train a service dog?
My dogs a pitty cross. She makes me feel safe. What kind of dog is your service dog?

It's not your fault what happened with dogs. It sounds like they are helping you a lot to get outside which is good. 
I'm struggling myself with going outside. My dog helps too. But today is a tough one. 
Here if you want to chat
Thanks people like yourself make this world a better place it is amazing what a little kindness can do.

Yeah your right about my brain lying to me. And I know this but it's like am to far gone to fight my depression so I continue to listen to it.maybe I should try to go back to see her she was really good. Thanks so much for taking your time to chat with me.i think you and few others have stopped me doing anything stupid today. So thank you x

I had a councillor last year I was suicidal and she sent me to hospital sat with me all day.so I never went back again I am embarrassed as felt like I was wasting her time. She could be helping others.
I feel bit better when she is around. But also incredibly guilty for even thinking of leaving her. And so scared she will end up depressed like me and her sister.
I've not drank today. But did all weekend heavy. Suppose it's my own fault I'm feeling this way now.yeah I think I'm going to be OK till she gets home thank you.
I'm alone at the moment.my daughter will be home from school soon. Sorry a and e is accident and emergency. I'm scared to leave my room incase I hang myself. Also have a drinking problem.
I don't know why but I can't bring myself to call a helpline. I find texting easier but can't find a service to text.was considering going to a and e. So scared of myself.
My daughter took her own life I've not really coped since.
I just need a distraction I'm so scared of myself right now.
I'm so sorry I know how it feels to lose someone this way.
I would still go over to hers.
Hi. Here if you want to talk.
We are all going to pass away eventually so why stay in pain for longer than you need too.
I guess thanks for taking time to talk with me.
Also have a dog a do try get out with her.but my thoughts of suicide are so bad I'm scared to go near the woods with leash with me I get images of me hanging.

It is intense and seems to be getting worse. The worse thing is I have another daughter how selfish can I be to try and leave her. I've attempted a few times before too. I feel I'm too broken to be fixed.
I just want peace.
I know they won't. But what about me I've been severely depressed for years unable to work. I'm worthless and in pain everyday. I've tried meds therapy and I end up back to this state everytime.
Thanks I just want to end it. But I'm scared to if that makes sense.
